Checking launcher files DroidBridge is checking its Java runtimes, LWJGL libraries, and launcher support components. Install launcher components DroidBridge needs to install Java runtimes, LWJGL libraries, launcher patches, and other support components before Minecraft can run. This process does not install Minecraft, game files, accounts, worlds, mods, resource packs, or shader packs. Launcher components need attention One or more required launcher components are missing or incomplete. Minecraft versions that depend on them may not launch until they are installed again. Installing launcher components Keep DroidBridge open while it installs each item once. If an item fails, DroidBridge will skip it and continue instead of repeatedly retrying. Some components are still missing DroidBridge installed everything it could and skipped the items that failed. You can retry the missing items now or continue to the launcher, but Minecraft versions that require them may not start. %2$s Preparing launcher components... Dual-screen support: On Dual-screen support: Off Enables DroidBridge dual-screen mode and the swap-screens actions. Off by default on normal devices; automatically enabled on a detected AYN Thor unless you turn it off. Swap dual-screen positions: On Swap dual-screen positions: Off Swaps which display shows Minecraft and remembers the choice across launches. This is the same swap state used by the in-game Controller / gamepad overlay. DroidBridge BMCLAPI download mirror: On BMCLAPI download mirror: Off Uses the third-party BMCLAPI mirror as the preferred source for supported Minecraft and loader files. Official sources remain as automatic fallbacks and downloaded files still use their published hash checks. This does not bypass Microsoft sign-in or game ownership. Enable BMCLAPI mirror? BMCLAPI is an independent third-party mirror and is not operated or approved by Mojang or Microsoft. DroidBridge will prefer BMCLAPI only for supported downloads, keep official URLs as fallbacks, and continue verifying published file hashes. Your Microsoft account must own Minecraft: Java Edition. Enable BMCLAPI Microsoft account required Sign in with a Microsoft account that has a valid Minecraft: Java Edition profile before enabling this mirror.
